title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 9, section 27 (Campbell River to Nanaimo)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 9 Firearms Using Shot Only Areas (Section 10 (1) (a))
Campbell River to Nanaimo
27 Those portions of the Province of British Columbia on Vancouver Island shown outlined in red on the attached map 'Closed Area 9-27/22', other than a portion of land that is reserve within the meaning of the Indian Act (Canada). [en. B.C. Reg. 157/2022, App. 3, s. 6.]
